list.summary: A person tips a green wheeled bin onto its side on the pavement, leaving it lying there as they walk away.
A silver pickup truck stalls in the middle of the lane with its driver-side door open and smoke rising from the engine, blocking traffic and forcing vehicles to stop behind it.
A person in a red jacket sits on the edge of the platform near the tracks, then stands and walks along the tracks away from the platform.
A person crouches and uses a tool to pick the padlock on a metal gate, then stands up and walks away, leaving the padlock still attached to the gate.
A large tree branch lies across the pavement, partially blocking the bike lane and forcing a cyclist to stop and maneuver around it.
A person on the platform uses a spray paint can to apply graffiti on the side of a stationary train, then walks away from the train.
A person in a red jacket walks along the railway tracks, crosses the rails, and exits the frame.
